proposal.clock_proposal: Bare hard PHY clock access must identify actual native M5 clk rectangle plus source hash, with exact slot/body transform. Any outer M7 clock port/via adapter requires explicit physical wiring; changing clock.tap alone is insufficient because clock_pins still snaps to partition tracks and abstract_lef fabricates M7 pin geometry. coll_ucie is mixed soft logic plus native PHY: preserve top/grid clocks separately, replace only native core entry and remove/reassign glue grid taps/stations inside PHY body before native build.

Every current outer payload/epoch port needs exact native-bit/constant wire mapping; all real native PHY pins remain accessible with no synthetic undeclared native epoch pins.
Do not replace coll_ucie soft wrapper by bare PHY; retain native core/body and soft logic/clock roles explicitly.
